summary: Trivial dispatch helper: calls BitFlagSetter on the byte element this[a2], requesting bit 1 be set, and returns the result. Used by EntityVisibilityGridManager.

operations.description: Call BitFlagSetter(&this[a2], 1) to set bit 1 on the byte at index a2 within the caller's byte array.
Return the value produced by BitFlagSetter.
